<noinclude>
Template for displaying safety incident information in a standardized format.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Safety Incident
|title=Chemical Spill Incident
|date=2025-01-15
|type=Chemical Spill
|severity=Minor
|location=Room 201
|equipment_involved=[[Equipment:Fume Hood]]
|personnel_involved=[[Personnel:Jane Smith]]
|protocol_involved=[[Protocol:Chemical Handling]]
|description=Small spill of ethanol during transfer
|resolution=Cleaned up immediately, no injuries
|follow_up_actions=Review chemical handling protocol
|status=Closed
|reported_by=[[Personnel:Jane Smith]]
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* title - Incident title (required)
* date - Incident date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* type - Incident type (Chemical Spill, Fire, Injury, Equipment Failure, etc.)
* severity - Severity (Minor, Moderate, Major, Critical)
* location - Location where incident occurred
* equipment_involved - Semicolon-separated list of equipment links
* personnel_involved - Semicolon-separated list of personnel links
* protocol_involved - Semicolon-separated list of protocol links
* description - Description of the incident
* resolution - How the incident was resolved
* follow_up_actions - Actions taken or planned
* status - Status (Open, Under Investigation, Closed)
* reported_by - Link to personnel who reported the incident

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
